transactions.citation: p831/849: 'Announced the proposed acquisition of the Osaka Data Centre for a purchase consideration of JPY52.0 billion'... 'Completed the acquisition of the Osaka Data Centre'; footnote 4 (p1726): 'JLL Morii Valuation & Advisory K.K. valued the property based on the cost approach and income capitalisation approach methods. The independent valuation of the property was JPY52.0 billion as at 30 April 2023.'; footnote 3 (p1724): 'MIT has an effective economic interest of 98.47% in the property while the remaining 1.53% is held by its Sponsor, MIPL.'
transactions.notes: Purchase consideration JPY52.0bn was 'in line with' (equal to) the JLL Morii independent valuation of JPY52.0bn as at 30 Apr 2023 -- i.e. a 0% premium/discount, but this is not populated as gain_loss_pct since that field is reserved for divestments per SPEC (no gain/loss concept applies to an acquisition). MIT holds a 98.47% effective economic interest in the property (remaining 1.53% held by Sponsor MIPL); purchase price recorded on the JPY-denominated, effective-interest basis as disclosed. Fit-out works were completed in phases across FY23/24 through FY25/26 (Phase 3 completed 25 Jun 2024, final Phase 4 completed 2 May 2025), each phase representing an incremental ~10% of the total purchase consideration paid on completion -- this is additional capex disclosed in subsequent years' ARs, not part of the FY2023 acquisition transaction itself.

transactions.sale_price_citation: p744: 'On 27 March 2024, we completed the divestment of 115A & 115B Commonwealth Drive, Singapore (the "Tanglin Halt Cluster") at a sale price of S$50.6 million.'
transactions.citation: p744: 'On 27 March 2024, we completed the divestment of 115A & 115B Commonwealth Drive, Singapore (the "Tanglin Halt Cluster") at a sale price of S$50.6 million. The sale price was at an 8.4% premium above book value.'; footnote 11 (p2099): 'Based on the book value of S$46.7 million as at the end of the Financial Year 2022/2023 ended 31 March 2023.'; footnote 12 (p2101): independent valuation by Savills Valuation and Professional Services (S) Pte Ltd.
transactions.notes: VERIFIED per user flag: the disclosed 8.4% is the GROSS sale price (S$50.6m) measured against BOOK VALUE (S$46.7m as at 31 Mar 2023 FYE, i.e. the prior comparative-period carrying amount) -- (50,600,000-46,700,000)/46,700,000*100 = 8.35%, rounds to the disclosed 8.4%; used the disclosed figure verbatim (pct_source='disclosed'), not the derived 8.35%. reference_basis correctly set to 'book_value' (not 'valuation'), matching the AR's own 'premium above book value' framing. A SEPARATE net-proceeds figure exists and must not be conflated with the gross sale price used for the 8.4%: net cash proceeds from the divestment were S$50.192m (Statement of Cash Flows, per prior extraction citation, p38 source_page) vs the gross sale price of S$50.6m -- a difference of S$408k in disposal costs/adjustments. Also note a distinct independent valuation of S$48.7m as at 31 Dec 2023 exists (Savills, per prior extraction) which is NOT the book-value reference used for the disclosed 8.4% -- had (50,600,000-48,700,000)/48,700,000 been used instead it would give a different +3.90% figure; the AR's own wording anchors explicitly to book value, so that valuation figure is not used as reference_value here. 100% interest divested (whole-property book-value entity), interest_pct left null.
